section.3: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah

3.name_native: The Book of Menstruation and Istihadah

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Samurah said:"I offered the funeral prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for Umm Ka'b who had died during childbirth, and during the prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood at her middle
